blockers.title: Blocker response distribution
blockers.empty_title: No blocker data (waiting for status-change history)
blockers.empty_desc: Blocker metrics are computed from status-change records (activity_log) of issues entering blocked → unblocked / first Agent reply. There is no history yet; data starts accumulating the next time an issue is marked blocked. Once the first complete sample exists, P50/P95 and details appear automatically. No action needed, other modules are unaffected.
